videos.desc: A long curved steel slide runs down a green mountain meadow, its polished grey chute filling the bottom half of the frame, with dark pine forest and hills behind. A spotted fawn lies curled up in the steel chute at the top of the slide. It sits up and looks straight down the slide at the camera with its ears out, settles back down into the chute, then gets to its feet and walks off into the tall grass beside the slide.

A mother brown bear and two cubs walk along a wide grey sand flat at low tide, below a steep mountainside streaked with snow, with pale glacial water behind them. A black raven stands on the sand nearby, spreads its wings and hops aside as the cubs trot past. The family walks on along the shoreline and away from the camera.

A small white Pomeranian stands on a dark grooming table in front of a window looking onto a sunny green garden. A groomer works round it with scissors, snipping the straggly hair on its back and legs; little tufts of white fur drop onto the table. The dog pants happily, screws its eyes shut while its face is cupped and shaped, and ends up with a perfectly round, smooth, even coat.

A couple crouches at a wire kennel door inside an animal rescue centre and greets a tan dog through the mesh; a staff member in a green polo shirt opens the kennel and the couple hug the dog; at the front desk the same woman stamps their adoption paperwork; the couple then walk the dog out on a red leash down the bright corridor and out through the exit.
videos.said: It's him. He's all yours. Let's go home.

videos.desc: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.

Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.

An orange and pink sunset over a flat coastal marsh. An enormous mass of starlings wheels across the sky, thousands of dark specks moving as one body and changing shape from a curl to an S to a wide spiral. People stand along a wooden boardwalk watching; an older woman in a plaid coat and beret points up at the birds while a grey-haired man beside her stares open-mouthed at the sky.

At sunrise on a city rooftop an old man with a white beard stands in front of a tall stack of wooden and wire bird cages with small birds inside, and unlatches the little doors one after another. Birds burst out of the cages and the sky fills with a huge flock. He holds an empty cage in his arms and looks up, and the crowd of people behind him watches the birds circle over the city.

A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.

Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

Two elderly men in suits meet in front of a tall white stone monument under a clear blue sky, shake hands warmly and then pull each other into a long hug while a crowd of onlookers watches. Rows of schoolgirls in navy uniforms line both sides of the paved square, each holding a wicker basket with white birds sitting inside. The girls tip the baskets open and the white birds burst upwards, first a handful and then dozens, until the whole sky above the monument is filled with them. The two men stand together at the centre looking up at the birds.

A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.

A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.

A bright, nearly empty room with a wooden floor, a pendant lamp and a tall window onto a spiral fire escape. A young man with curly hair and a beard, in a long navy coat, stands stiffly and points his finger straight at a grey-and-white husky. The dog sits in a huge mess of white stuffing pulled out of a torn mustard-yellow cushion and howls back at him. The man lowers his arm and starts to smile, and the husky lies down on the cushion. A lake painting hangs on the wall.

A bright open-plan flat with a grey sofa, plants and a light wooden kitchen. A young woman with long dark hair, in a pale blue lounge set, sits on the sofa while a black-and-white border collie tugs at her sleeve. She looks startled, turns towards the kitchen, jumps up and hurries over, with her blanket lying on the floor. Behind them a steel pot on the stove is boiling over, sending up clouds of steam and water running down the oven, and the dog runs to the kitchen too.

At a sunny riverside picnic under a weeping willow, with wooden rowing boats moored on the water, a young woman with red hair, in a blue crop top and a long cream skirt, kneels on the rug biting a sandwich and glancing sideways, one arm stretched out behind her. Right behind her a brown and white goat holds a cardboard cake box in its mouth and walks along. In front two friends lie on the rug laughing over plates of sandwiches, and the young man looks up at the goat. A white jug and a wicker basket stand on the rug.

On a cobbled village street in warm evening light, a young woman in a cream shirt and jeans crouches and holds the face of a big shaggy grey dog, smiling as it leans into her. An older man in a baker's apron steps out of a stone doorway and holds out a piece of bread to the dog, a woman behind him holds a wooden crate, and a bearded man on a ladder leans down to look. Food bowls stand on the pavement and more villagers stand further along the street.

In a sunny stone courtyard under a grapevine pergola, a young woman with curly hair in a lilac cropped jumper and black trousers holds a small brown puppy and gives a half-reluctant smile. A young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt and beige trousers reaches out, scratches the puppy's chin and leans in close to it. She softens, laughs and lifts the puppy up happily as he smiles. A metal water bowl and a striped blanket lie on the flagstones by a blue wooden door.

A young woman with curly dark hair and gold hoop earrings, in a lilac knitted top and a cream skirt, takes a mirror selfie with her phone. A grey parrot with a red tail stands on her shoulder and keeps flapping its wings next to her face. She frowns, squints and pushes her hand towards it, then lowers the phone, rubs her forehead and looks annoyed. The room has mint-green walls, blue wooden shutters, a cane chair with clothes, a bird perch and an amber chandelier.

Beside a calm lake with pine trees and a wooden cabin, in warm evening light, a young man with a short beard, in a loose white linen shirt and light trousers, holds a big tortoise against his chest with one arm. He feeds it a red strawberry, looks at it fondly as it chews, then offers it another strawberry. A bowl of strawberries sits on a wooden picnic table in front, and a raised flower bed full of colourful flowers and a metal watering can stand behind him.

In a supermarket car park at dusk in heavy rain, the wet tarmac shining under street lamps, a young woman in a grey sweatshirt and jeans crouches and holds her open black coat out wide over a small wet shaggy dog. She wraps the coat around the dog, picks it up and walks towards the camera, hugging it to her chest. A shopping trolley with a carrier bag stands behind her, and a middle-aged woman, an older man and a man in a hooded jacket stand watching in front of the brightly lit shop.

At a wildlife rescue centre in soft golden evening light, a smiling young man in a green work shirt and white trousers feeds a baby elephant from a big plastic milk bottle and strokes its back. The little elephant wears a red and green checked blanket, swings its trunk and drinks, milk dripping from its mouth. The man then bends down and rests his head against the elephant's head while it curls its trunk up over him. A fence of rough wooden poles, a tin-roofed shelter and acacia trees stand around them on the red earth.

On a snowy shore in Antarctica on a clear, sunny day, with white icebergs floating on the dark blue sea behind, a young woman in a yellow beanie, a red padded jacket, black trousers and gloves stands beside her backpack. A line of gentoo penguins with black backs, white bellies and orange beaks waddles past her one by one, and she points at each of them, counting, then lowers her arm. Further along the shore people in red and dark jackets work beside a white box, and footprints cover the snow.

A huge grown elephant with long curved white tusks and big ears walks across a dry golden savanna at sunset. Right beside its front legs trots a tiny baby elephant, lifting its short trunk and kicking up dust. The big elephant swings its trunk down and gently touches the baby's back as they walk on together. The grass is tall and pale, flat-topped acacia trees stand behind them and low hills fade into the warm orange haze of the evening sky.

A laughing young woman in a yellow dress and a woven apron stands by a wooden fruit cart full of mangoes and papayas under a striped awning on a cobbled square with colourful old houses and palm trees. She holds a piece of mango high in the air while more bright green parrots with yellow and red markings fly in and land on her raised hand and her shoulder. Behind her a man at a café table ducks under a metal tray as the parrots flap past.

At night inside an old stone barn with arched doorways and a lit oil lantern hanging from a beam, a young woman in a knitted hat and waxed green jacket kneels in the straw with her hands pressed to her mouth, moved and amazed. In front of her a ewe licks a tiny newborn white lamb that stands up on shaky legs. The woman lowers her hands, smiles and claps softly. A metal bucket and a towel lie beside her, and other sheep look over a wooden pen.

On a mountain farm on a sunny day, with a stone house, a stone wall and snowy peaks behind, a big shaggy male goat with a long beard and huge curved horns stands on the roof of a small old cream-coloured car. A young woman in a red checked shirt, green dungarees and rubber boots holds up a carrot to it, and the goat takes it, rears up on its back legs and lands on the roof again while she watches with her hands on her hips. More goats stand along the wall.

Low down in a sandy riding arena on a cloudy day, a bay horse pushes its head towards the camera and pulls a funny face, lips pulled back to show its big teeth around the shiny metal ring and bar in its mouth, joined to the leather bridle and reins. Drool drips from its mouth. The young woman riding it in a black helmet and navy fleece laughs out loud. Behind them a man stands by white jumping poles and a rider on a grey horse waits.

At a rural cattle show on an overcast day, a shaggy ginger Highland cow with long curved horns charges towards the camera across the grass, its lead rope flying loose in the air. A young woman with braids in a white show coat reaches after it, and more handlers in white coats stand behind. The cow swerves and gallops along a wooden fence lined with spectators, who lean back as it passes. Other Highland cattle stand in a line, and a tipped bucket and a brush lie on the grass.

At an outdoor farm show under a cloudy blue sky, a big pink pig wearing prize rosettes and a PRIZE WINNER sash leaps high out of a show ring covered in wood shavings, its rope trailing behind. A young woman in a white coat dives after it and lands on her knees. The pig lands, scrambles over the edge of the ring and runs off past the camera, while the woman gets up laughing. Older men in tweed jackets and flat caps holding clipboards watch, with other pigs and a striped marquee behind.

A robin perches on a snow- and ice-covered metal railing in a blizzard, seen close up. Its bright orange breast is puffed out and its belly is white. It opens its beak as if singing, turns its head and closes its beak again as the view moves closer. Long icicles hang from the rail below it, snowflakes blow sideways, and far behind, blurred orange lights glow through the white haze near a dark rock face. Snow settles on its brown back and wings.

Inside a wooden barn on a cold winter morning, a young man in a waxed jacket and green rubber boots, with a towel hanging from his pocket, bends down and gently sets a newborn black-and-white lamb onto the straw. He straightens up and watches as a ewe stretches forward to sniff the lamb, which stands on its own. A flock of white sheep crowds behind, a sheepdog sits by the metal gate, hay bales are stacked above, an oil lantern glows and breath steams in the air.

On a straight country road through golden grassland with blue mountains beyond, a huge shaggy brown bison stands right beside a red vintage convertible, its dark woolly head and short curved horn next to the side mirror, snorting dust. In the driver's seat a young woman in a white shirt and a yellow headscarf freezes with a sandwich at her mouth. The bison lifts its head, steps forward and walks slowly past the car, and she stares after it. More bison cross the road behind, and a straw hat lies on the asphalt.

From the back of an open safari vehicle on a dusty track in golden evening light, a large elephant with wide ears and white tusks walks straight towards the vehicle, raising dust, and comes very close, with the rest of the herd and young calves following behind. The guide in a khaki shirt and green shorts stands up in the vehicle and holds up one hand. A driver and two women tourists sit in the seats, and acacia trees and hills fill the background.

On a tropical beach at dusk with palm trees and a thatched beach bar with lights, a group of cows of different colours wanders along the sand and the water's edge. A pale cow and a small dark calf walk side by side through the foaming waves towards the camera. A spotted cow lies on a striped beach towel under a pink umbrella, and other cows stand by sun loungers and a surfboard on the sand. Wooden fishing boats rest further along the beach.
